The Humans build the first massive city in Escarth, Praetoria. It is the center of their civilization and marks the beginning of the magic era of humanity. It is the largest mortal city since Atlas and is known for its legendary heroes and center of the adventuring trade. Founded and led by the first elected king Lazarus. He was known as the King of Kings, said to have ruled for a thousand years and been one of the greatest mortals to have ever lived.
